name: INTO the ART - MUSEUM
summary:
Step into a museum shaped by the artist it celebrates. From Van Gogh’s swirling skies to the deep blue of Hokusai’s gallery, each virtual museum has its own palette, sky and architecture inspired by the artist’s style.

Explore more than 20 works by each artist and follow the course of their artistic career. See how their style changed, spot recurring themes and learn about the world in which each work was created.
